svg.title: E07 DISCOVERY TRIDENT engineering architecture
svg.desc: Science availability is conditioned on record comparability and two surviving acceptable records. A separate dependency branch preserves shared faults; pairwise agreement remains distinct from absolute calibration accuracy.
